fact_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
fact_list_empty: There are no active facts for this server yet.
ask_not_configured: Aura's question-answering isn't set up on this server yet. Ask a server admin to configure it.
ask_no_info: I don't have any information about that yet.
ask_error: Something went wrong while putting together an answer. Please try again in a moment.
ask_grounding_rejected: I put an answer together, but it wasn't fully backed by this server's recorded facts, so I'm not sending it. Try asking more specifically, or check with a moderator.
ask_grounding_unverified: I put an answer together, but couldn't verify it against this server's facts just now — and I won't send an answer I haven't checked. Please try again in a moment.
config_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
config_no_options_error: Specify at least one of `proactive` or `extraction` to change something.
config_proactive_enabled: Proactive replies are now **on** in {channel}. Aura may volunteer an answer there when it's confident.
config_proactive_disabled: Proactive replies are now **off** in {channel}. Aura will stay silent there unless asked directly.
config_extraction_enabled: Automatic fact extraction is now **on** in {channel}. Aura may read messages there for facts to remember.
config_extraction_disabled: Automatic fact extraction is now **off** in {channel}. Aura will not read messages there for facts.
proactive_reply_label: 💡 Aura noticed a question in this channel
proactive_reply_footer: Aura volunteered this because it was confident — nobody asked it directly. A moderator can turn this off with /aura-config.
debug_signals_trail: S1 {stage1} · S2 {stage2} · Cooldown {cooldown} · Cap {cap} · Grace {grace} · Synth {synthesis}
debug_signals_verdict_ambiguous_facts: Two facts too close to call
debug_signals_empty: No question signals have been recorded for this server yet.
debug_signals_footer: Diagnostic view of Aura's proactive pipeline — this command itself never posts and is only visible to you.
debug_signals_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
supersede_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
supersede_fact_not_found: Fact #{fact_id} doesn't exist in this server.
supersede_old_already_superseded: Fact #{fact_id} is already superseded, so it can't be superseded again.
supersede_new_not_active: Fact #{fact_id} isn't currently active, so it can't be the successor of another fact.
supersede_success: Fact #{old_fact_id} is now superseded by fact #{new_fact_id}.
supersede_expired: Confirmation timed out. Nothing was changed.
supersede_wrong_user_error: Only the moderator who ran this command can confirm it.
supersede_old_race_error: Fact #{fact_id} was already superseded by someone else just now. Nothing was changed.
supersede_new_race_error: Fact #{fact_id} is no longer active (it may have just been superseded itself). Nothing was changed.
pending_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
pending_none: There are no fact candidates waiting for review.
pending_review_footer: {remaining} candidate(s) waiting. Aura suggested this automatically — it only becomes a real fact if you confirm it.
pending_similar_hint: If it replaces that fact rather than adding to it, confirm this candidate and then run /aura-supersede with old fact #{fact_id}.
pending_discarded: Candidate #{pending_id} discarded. No fact was created.
pending_race_error: Candidate #{pending_id} was already reviewed by someone else just now. Nothing was changed.
pending_expired: Review timed out. The candidate is still waiting.
pending_wrong_user_error: Only the moderator who ran this command can review this candidate.
pending_relationship_supersession: Replacement — the candidate updates that fact.
pending_relationship_complementary: Complementary — both stay true side by side.
pending_relationship_contradiction: Conflict — both cannot be true, and nothing says which one is current.
pending_relationship_independent: Unrelated — they only look similar; they are about different things.
pending_relationship_hint_supersession: If you agree: confirm this candidate, then run /aura-supersede with old fact #{fact_id} to retire it.
pending_relationship_hint_complementary: No /aura-supersede needed — confirming this candidate leaves fact #{fact_id} active beside it.
pending_relationship_hint_contradiction: Aura will not guess this one. Open both source messages and check which one still holds before you confirm or discard.
pending_relationship_hint_independent: Fact #{fact_id} is unaffected either way — the similarity was a false positive.
digest_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
digest_no_options_error: Specify at least one of `channel`, `interval` or `enabled` to change something.
digest_channel_required: Pick a channel first, e.g. /aura-digest channel:#announcements.
digest_already_off: The periodic digest is already off for this server.
digest_enabled: The periodic digest is now **on** in {channel}, {interval}. The first one arrives after that period and covers only what changes from now on — it won't repost what Aura already knows.
digest_updated: Digest settings updated: posting in {channel}, {interval}. The current period keeps running.
digest_disabled: The periodic digest is now **off**. The channel and interval are kept for when you turn it back on.
digest_permission_warning: ⚠️ Aura can't post in {channel} right now (it needs Send Messages and Embed Links there), so no digest will arrive until that's fixed.
digest_footer: Automatic summary of Aura's knowledge, posted {interval}. A moderator can change or stop it with /aura-digest.
onboarding_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
onboarding_no_options_error: Specify at least one of `channel` or `enabled` to change something.
onboarding_channel_required: Pick a channel first, e.g. /aura-onboarding channel:#welcome.
onboarding_already_off: Onboarding messages are already off for this server.
onboarding_enabled: Onboarding messages are now **on** in {channel}. The next member who joins will see a summary of what's currently active here.
onboarding_updated: Onboarding settings updated: now posting in {channel}.
onboarding_disabled: Onboarding messages are now **off**. The channel is kept for when you turn it back on.
onboarding_permission_warning: ⚠️ Aura can't post in {channel} right now (it needs Send Messages and Embed Links there), so new members won't get an onboarding message until that's fixed.
onboarding_title: Welcome! Here's what's currently active on this server
onboarding_intro: A summary of Aura's current knowledge, condensed for new members.
onboarding_capped_note: {count} more active fact(s) aren't shown here.
onboarding_footer: Aura's summary of what's currently active here. Ask anytime with /aura-ask.
link_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
link_self_error: A fact can't be linked to itself.
link_fact_not_found: Fact #{fact_id} doesn't exist in this server.
link_fact_not_active: Fact #{fact_id} is superseded, so it can't be linked.
link_fact_superseded: Fact #{fact_id} is superseded by fact #{successor_id}. Link that one instead.
link_race_missing_error: One of those facts stopped existing just now. Nothing was linked.
link_race_superseded_error: One of those facts was superseded by someone else just now. Nothing was linked.
link_success: Facts #{fact_a_id} and #{fact_b_id} are now linked. Aura can cite them together from now on.
link_already_linked: Facts #{fact_a_id} and #{fact_b_id} were already linked. Nothing was changed.
unlink_self_error: A fact can't be unlinked from itself.
unlink_success: The link between facts #{fact_a_id} and #{fact_b_id} was removed.
unlink_not_linked: Facts #{fact_a_id} and #{fact_b_id} weren't linked. Nothing was changed.
backfill_permission_error: You need the Manage Server permission to do that.
backfill_wrong_guild_error: That channel belongs to a different server.
backfill_extraction_disabled_error: Aura isn't allowed to read {channel} for facts yet. Turn that on first with /aura-config channel:{channel} extraction:true — backfilling a channel nobody opted in would be two decisions in one command.
backfill_already_running: A backfill is already running in {channel}.
backfill_resumed: Backfill resumed in {channel}. It carries on exactly where it stopped.
backfill_resume_raced: That backfill in {channel} changed state a moment ago — check /aura-backfill status.
backfill_resume_since_conflict: {channel} has a paused backfill, and resuming keeps its original range. Run /aura-backfill start without `since` to resume it, or /aura-backfill cancel first to begin a new one from a different date.
backfill_since_invalid_error: `since` must be a past date written as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2025-03-14. It is read as UTC midnight.
backfill_started_all: Backfill started in {channel}, covering everything up to now.
backfill_started_since: Backfill started in {channel}, covering everything from {since} (UTC) up to now.
backfill_started_explainer: It reads oldest to newest, stops after {cap} distillation calls per day and continues the next day, and everything it finds goes to /aura-pending for review — nothing becomes a fact on its own. Messages written from now on are handled by normal extraction instead.
backfill_paused: Backfill paused in {channel}. Its place is kept; /aura-backfill start resumes it.
backfill_pause_not_running: There is no running backfill in {channel} to pause.
backfill_cancelled: Backfill ended in {channel}. Anything it already found stays in /aura-pending for review.
backfill_cancel_nothing_active: There is no running or paused backfill in {channel} to end.
backfill_status_budget: Today's budget: {spent} of {cap} distillation calls used. It resets at midnight UTC.
backfill_status_none: No backfill has been started in this server yet. /aura-backfill start channel:#some-channel begins one.
backfill_progress: Read up to {position} — {scanned} message(s) scanned, {staged} candidate(s) staged, {calls} distillation call(s) spent.
backfill_state_completed: Finished — it reached the end of the history.
backfill_state_failed: Stopped: the channel could not be read (deleted, or Aura lost Read Message History there).
operator_budget_permission_error: This command is restricted to Aura's operator.
